title: Local data at the singular points of an excellent normal surface
statement: Let $X$ be a normal integral Noetherian excellent scheme of dimension $2$ [def-pc-integral-scheme, def-weil-pbc-normal-ring, def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring, def-exc-excellent-ring, def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. Noetherian means that $X$ has a finite affine open cover by spectra of Noetherian rings; excellent means that the ring of every affine open is excellent. Then $X_{\rm reg}=\{x:\mathcal O_{X,x}\text{ is regular local}\}$ is open [def-weil-regular-scheme], and $X\setminus X_{\rm reg}$ is a finite set of closed points. For each of these points $x$, the ring $A=\mathcal O_{X,x}$ is an excellent Noetherian normal local domain of dimension $2$, and its maximal-ideal-adic completion $\widehat A$ is a complete Noetherian normal local domain of dimension $2$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion].

The finite singular set is the normal-surface observation used in resolve.tex, Tag 0BGN.
